text:
Ravi (Partnerships): Jo from NovaTek reports PO-NOVA-3001-3004 stuck in "awaiting-invoice" after we applied SKU de-dup rule. Partner says orders were accepted but our ingest collapsed two lines into one.
Sana - Deal Desk: Those are core demo units + support SKUs for the reseller pilot. If invoices don't match PO lines, finance will reject.
Tim (Marketplace Ops): Our de-dup rule merged identical product_id lines if identical metadata; looks like NovaTek includes different batch_meta but same sku string so we deduped incorrectly. Rolling back rule is heavy.
Jo - Hardware (NovaTek): We can change our EDI to include batch_id but that'll take a day. Any temporary tolerance you can enable?
Eve (Legal): Quick note: any change to line item interpretation must be auditable. Please keep original raw payloads.
Tim (Marketplace Ops): Quick mitigation: add a per-partner passthrough flag so we skip de-dup for nova-partner-id for 24h. I'll PR and canary.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline #9721 started for validation-service-canary
Sana - Deal Desk: Please do. Also tag these POs as "lineitem-exception" so finance knows to accept invoices with reconciliation notes.
Ravi (Partnerships): I'll tell NovaTek to resend EDI with batch_id today; if not, we'll accept invoices with reconciliation.
Tim (Marketplace Ops): Canary green. Flipping for partner nova-772 now.
Tim (Marketplace Ops): POs moved to "vendor-ack". :white_check_mark:
Jo - Hardware (NovaTek): We see ack, thanks. We'll follow up with corrected EDI tonight.
Eve (Legal): Logging required reconciliation note template and raw payload retention for 30 days.
Sana - Deal Desk: Marked POs and notified finance to expect reconciliation lines.
Ravi (Partnerships): Note action items: (1) NovaTek to resend corrected EDI (2) Ops to remove passthrough after 24h (3) Legal to add reconciliation note template. Closing unless issues.
